caption:
Meta's new AI remembers you across chats, and tries another route when a task gets stuck.

Meta just announced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full (October 12). Muse Wonder is its most capable model for personal and professional agent tasks. Two features stand out: Active Memory keeps context about you between conversations, and Active Focus works around blockers and checks in before important actions.

→ Muse Wonder: live in Meta's Model API and Muse Code
→ Muse Wonder Full: for Muse Code subscribers
→ Muse app: coming soon, subscribers first
→ Prices and usage limits: not on the announcement page yet

captions.facebook:
Meta's new AI remembers you across chats, and tries another route when a task gets stuck.

Meta announced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on October 12. The idea: an AI that doesn't start from zero every time you open a chat. Active Memory keeps the context about you that matters, and Active Focus is what happens when the first try fails: it works around the blocker and checks with you before anything important.

Muse Wonder is live now in Meta's Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers, and the Muse app is coming soon. Meta hasn't published prices, usage limits or benchmark scores yet, so wait for real tests before you switch.

slides.voiceover: Meet Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, announced October twelfth.

slides.label: Feature 1
slides.title: It keeps context about you across conversations
slides.sub: And pulls up the details that matter for the task you're on.
slides.voiceover: Active Memory keeps important context about you across conversations, then retrieves what fits the task.

slides.label: Feature 2
slides.title: Hard task? It tries another way
slides.sub: Works around blockers, adapts to new info, and checks in before important actions.
slides.voiceover: Active Focus means it tries other approaches when it hits a wall, and checks in before big actions.

slides.label: Where to try it
slides.title: Where you can use it right now
slides.voiceover: Wonder is live in Meta's Model API and Muse Code. Full is for Muse Code subscribers.
